operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israeli Fire Kills Four Palestinians Including 11-Year-Old in Al-Mawasi 'Safe Zone' as Ceasefire Violations Reach 347th Day
heroSubtitle: On Day 1076 (Sep 21, 2026), Israeli tank fire on displaced-persons' tents in the al-Mawasi 'safe zone' west of Khan Younis killed 11-year-old Ismail al-Bardawil; an Israeli drone killed Mohsen Ahmed Bahjat in Jabalia; tank fire killed 31-year-old Fidaa Toutah on Salah al-Din Street east of Nuseirat as she returned from taking her children to school; and a separate drone strike killed an unnamed man in Khan Younis city center hours later. Gaza's Health Ministry put the ceasefire-period toll at 1,394 killed and 4,839 wounded since the October 2025 truce, and the cumulative toll since Oct 7, 2023 at 73,914 killed — the 347th consecutive day of reported ceasefire violations. On Day 1075 (Sep 20, 2026), the IDF and Shin Bet disclosed killing three Hamas operatives over the weekend — Yahya Hamdouna and Mohammad Rafa'i, both Daraj-Tuffah Battalion members who took part in the October 7 attack, and Basir al-Barsh, whom the military named a Nukhba Force commander. The third matches Basir al-Bursh, the 28-year-old son of Gaza Health Ministry director-general Munir al-Bursh, killed in a drone strike a day earlier; his family and Palestinian officials dispute the militant characterization, saying he was helping displaced people fill water containers when he was struck. Two more Palestinians were wounded by gunfire near Khan Younis. Gaza's Health Ministry put the cumulative toll since Oct 7, 2023 at 73,910+ killed and 174,935+ wounded, and the ceasefire-period toll at 1,393 killed and 4,822 wounded (831 bodies recovered from rubble) — the 346th consecutive day of reported ceasefire violations. On Day 1074 (Sep 19), an Israeli drone strike killed Basir al-Bursh in Jabalia's az-Zahra neighborhood; a separate drone strike on a vehicle in Sheikh Radwan, Gaza City, killed 24-year-old Mohammad Khaled al-Refa'ey and wounded 4+ including 2 children; a Shujaiya strike killed one more person; and a Palestinian girl died of wounds from Friday's Israeli gunfire near Nuseirat. On Day 1073 (Sep 18, 2026), Israeli soldiers shot and killed Karam Mus'ad al-Masar'a on Julis Street in the Nuseirat refugee camp, central Gaza, and wounded two more Palestinians near Nasser Medical Complex west of Khan Younis — the 344th consecutive day of reported ceasefire violations since the October 2025 truce. On Day 1072 (Sep 17), Israeli drone strikes killed Youssef al-Zaim near the 17th Roundabout in western Gaza City and Mohammad Nasser Suleiman al-Bayouk in Nahr al-Bared, Khan Younis; a strike on Ad-Daraj School in central Gaza City wounded two, and a Sheikh Ajlin strike wounded around 10; Sa'id Barham died of wounds from an earlier strike; and the IDF disclosed killing Hamas Nukhba operative Muhammad Jamal Ahmad Eid in Bureij and naval-force platoon commander Saleh Ziad Ibrahim Miqdad in Gaza City. Gaza's Health Ministry reported 5 killed and 28 wounded strip-wide in that 24-hour period, putting the ceasefire-period toll at 1,386 killed and 4,784 wounded, and the cumulative Gaza toll since Oct 7, 2023 at 73,821+ killed. On Day 1062 (Sep 7, 2026), Israeli strikes killed five Palestinians across Gaza in 24 hours despite the ceasefire: a drone strike killed Mohammad Sukkar (28) in Rimal, Gaza City; a vehicle strike killed Yousef Aqila and his 7-year-old daughter Wafaa as they returned from buying school supplies; an artillery strike on the Sakina School shelter in Deir al-Balah killed 7-year-old Saadi Ghalia; and Hassan Ali Saqallah (19) was also killed in Gaza City, with 17 more wounded strip-wide. The IDF separately disclosed killing a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative in Gaza City's Shati camp on Sep 6 and a Hamas Nukhba member in a prior strike, alongside a rare disclosure that it diverted a munition mid-air to avoid civilians. US envoy Jared Kushner, in Kyiv, said Israel's government is acting 'a little irrational' on Gaza because of next month's election — a rare public rebuke of Netanyahu by a senior Trump official. Gaza's Health Ministry put the cumulative toll at 73,658+ killed since Oct 7, 2023, and the ceasefire-period toll at 1,352 killed, 4,511 wounded. On Day 1061 (Sep 6), an Israeli strike killed two, including a girl, in Al-Nasr, Gaza City; Gaza City held a mass funeral for 100 people, including 60 children, recovered from Zeitoun rubble; eight Muslim-majority nations warned of 'grave consequences' over Defense Minister Katz's and National Security Minister Ben Gvir's Gaza-displacement proposals; and Netanyahu said he 'attacked Qatar' while defending Qatari aid-fund transfers to Gaza. On Day 1060 (Sep 5), rescue teams recovered the remains of 55 Malka family members from Zeitoun rubble and a new Freedom Flotilla mission set sail toward Gaza. On Day 1059 (Sep 4), the US State Department publicly rejected Israeli displacement plans, citing Trump's peace-plan guarantee against forced departure. On Day 1058 (Sep 3), an Israeli drone strike on Rimal killed a 13-year-old, the IDF shot dead two Palestinians crossing the Yellow Line near Beit Lahia, and Ben Gvir unveiled 'Disengagement 710,' a plan to remove 1.86 million Palestinians from Gaza over seven years.
